issue.title: Podcast -f overwrite reports name what the new dossier attached (duration, capture, pages)

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-os.10 note #1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP); triaged by the bob-cli-os land agent.

`bob ref create <Spotify episode> -f overwrite` (real and `-d`) prints only the generic overwrite block (overwrite/title/archive/task/audio/sync). The dossier report lines a fresh create prints are missing: `duration:`, `capture: episode dossier · N chapters · publisher show notes · publisher transcript N words`, and `pages: N · size: …`. Both legacy-ref upgrades did attach publisher transcripts (59 and 37 pages), but the report never said so.

Root cause: `overwrite_podcast` (`src/native/highlights_ref/create/podcast_route.rs`) hands off to the shared `finish_local_overwrite` → `overwrite::local::print_success`, which every overwrite route shares. Its dry run calls `overwrite::local::print_dry_run` before any metadata fetch. Proposal:
- after a real podcast overwrite, print `duration:`, `capture:` (`Dossier::capture_summary`), and `pages:`/`size:` before the final `sync:` line (that likely means splitting `print_success_report` from `print_commit_result` the way `collection.rs` does);
- optionally, have the `-d` overwrite fetch metadata and print the `feed:`/`transcript:` dry-run lines, as a fresh `-d` does.

Extend `tests/cli/highlights/podcast_create.rs::reread_files_a_second_reading_and_overwrite_replaces_in_place`.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The epic plan only required overwrite to keep parity with the arXiv route, and arXiv, web, and podcast overwrites all print the same generic block today. A podcast-specific report is a new capability beyond the landed epic, not an epic defect.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-os.10 found podcast overwrite reports hide what the new dossier attached (transcript, chapters, pages). The landed epic matched arXiv overwrite parity, so this is filed as a small follow-up instead of reopening the epic.
